job: Watch a stream of lines and search them without losing your place.
purpose: A viewer on a sunken well with search, level chips (debug, info, warn, error), Follow, wrap and download. It follows new lines and stops the moment the reader scrolls up, with a "Jump to latest" button. The terminal variant plays a CLI session. appendLog(el, entry) adds a line; ANSI colour codes become tone spans. Without data-fit the body keeps its height.
useWhen: A job, a crawl or a deployment writes lines as it runs.
One run's lines sit on its page: use data-fit.
A CLI session is shown as a terminal.
People link to a line of a finished log, or need to land on the first error.
